# JInfo 0.3.0

One release with all JInfo components for Minecraft 26.2.

## Downloads

| File | Component | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `JInfo-Client-0.3.0.jar` | Client mod (Fabric) | `.minecraft/mods` with Fabric API |
| `JInfo-Server-Fabric-0.3.0.jar` | Server mod (Fabric) | server `mods/` with Fabric API |
| `JInfo-Server-Paper-0.3.0.jar` | Server plugin (Paper) | server `plugins/` |

The server components provide profiles through chat commands. They do not open a web page and do not require the client mod.

## Server commands

`/jinfo me`, `view <name|uuid>`, `set <text>`, `photo <url|off>`, `clear`.

Admin commands: `list`, `import`, `remove`, `reload`.
